summary: Conjugate self-duality from the eigenform; the local conditions from sphericity off the chosen places and from the label-compatibility at the chosen places and their conjugates; the labelled clause from the product label.

steps.claim: At each chosen place w_i, R is labelled by the product label (Attached.isLabelledAt).
steps.lean: (c · * (X - 1) ^ (card m - card r)) S R := have L i := (hR.isLabelledAt (A := ·) hf he (h i))

steps.claim: R is a column: conjugate self-dual (isConjSelfDual_of_attached); at places where f is spherical R is good with the jumps of κ (sphericalCompat_std, isGoodAt_iff); at the chosen places and their conjugates the clauses come from step 1 and local_clauses_of_conjPlace.
steps.lean:
⟨⟨isConjSelfDual_of_attached he hR, fun v k A hA ↦ by grind [(sphericalCompat_std v hf he).2 hR,
    local_clauses_of_conjPlace (isConjSelfDual_of_attached he hR), !isChosen_chosenPlace hc.1,
    hA.conjPlace_star, isGoodAt_iff]⟩

steps.claim: Labelled: the killing polynomial from step 1 is ∏ over the roots of c_i·(X − 1)^{Σt} with Σt = |m| − |r| (HasProductLabel).
steps.lean:
, fun i A _ _ H ↦ by simpa [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, ← (h
    i).2.2.1] using ((L i A H.1).2.2 H).1⟩
